title: Count the dimension-1 readers of X102
body:
## Summary
- X102 is the only channel on its initial line. That line belongs to departure slots 204 and 205, and both slots are compatible.
- Those slots lie on 16 of the 2,309 compatible edges. Under the archived contact rule, those 16 edges are X102's dimension-1 readers. Dimensions 2 through 8 contribute no further readers.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The read-first transfer is not run.
